description: Open the FibX app: wallet, balances, signing policy, and a swap form with the Fibrous route. Call this FIRST for anything about the wallet, a balance, a quote, or a swap — it returns the session, balances, policy and quote in one snapshot, so get_auth_status, get_balance, get_policy and get_quote are not needed before it. It executes nothing; where the host renders MCP Apps UI the user sees the app and presses Simulate and Swap themselves. Pass from/to/amount to open it pre-filled with a quote. Supported chains: Base, HyperEVM, Monad. If the host does not render UI, the result is still a complete JSON snapshot you can read and summarise.

amount.description: Amount of the source token, to pre-fill a swap

from.description: Source token symbol, to pre-fill a swap

slippage.description: Slippage percent for the pre-filled quote

to.description: Destination token symbol, to pre-fill a swap

name: open_fibx
title: Open FibX
